Validates with 0x1442c5e60(owner, ctx), optionally remaps the name through the string pool at map+0x50 (object type 0x14612bad8, string at +0x10), hashes it with djb2 (seed 0x1505, x33) and probes the robin-hood table (+0x18 entries, +0x20 info, +0x30 mask). If missing it creates a value object from the string type desc 0x146ca7508, calls its vfunc +0x40(value) and inserts it; if present and string typed it only calls vfunc +0x40. Returns 0, 0x16 (null name), 0xc (alloc) or 0x58 (type mismatch / insert failed).
